maddeler.e:
يعتصرا (form VIII)
# يَعْتَصِرَا (yaʕtaṣirā) /jaʕ.ta.sˤi.raː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# يُعْتَصَرَا (yuʕtaṣarā) /juʕ.ta.sˤa.raː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
